appeals.title: Appeals Process
appeals.description: If you believe a moderation action was taken in error, you can appeal by contacting our support team. All appeals are reviewed by senior moderators within 48 hours.

step2.title: Select Violation Type
step2.description: Choose the specific rule violation from the provided options.

step3.title: Provide Details
step3.description: Add any additional context that helps our moderation team understand the issue.
